sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, centroid x/y) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/princess/sun-princess/v3/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one <path class="cabin-shape" data-cabin> per stateroom. UNLIKE Royal Caribbean, Princess deckmaps SVGs do NOT encode stateroom category: every cabin path is fill="#fff" with a black stroke and the background PNG is monochrome line-art, so category cannot be read from colour. Category was instead derived by spatially registering each deckmaps cabin centroid against the category-coded HTML image-map regions (<area title="Category XX">) on cruisedeckplans.com deck-by-deck pages (deckbydeck.php?ship=Sun-Princess&deck=<N>), per-deck affine/bbox registration validated against cruisedeckplans' listed accessible cabins (known number+category) and cross-checked against cruisedeckplans' published per-category totals. Category-code legend (IA/O3/DF/D1/DG/MA/C1/S9 ...) taken from cruisedeckplans category tooltips.

notes.completeness: FULL geometry grid: all 2157 staterooms across the 10 guest decks (5,6,9,10,11,12,14,15,16,17). Per-deck counts (161,158,116,281,294,276,271,256,248,96) and the 2157 total match deckmaps' advertised count AND Sun Princess's real published capacity (~2157 cabins) exactly. No cabin number was invented; every number+position comes straight from the deckmaps SVGs.
notes.category: APPROXIMATE / DERIVED, not from the geometry source. Princess deckmaps SVGs carry no category colour (all fills #fff), so categories were assigned by spatially matching each cabin to cruisedeckplans.com's category-coded deck-plan regions. Validation: 49/54 (~91%) of cruisedeckplans' listed accessible-cabin anchors were reproduced correctly; aggregate per-category counts land within ~3% of cruisedeckplans' own published totals (e.g. Interior 456 vs 460, Deluxe Balcony 966 vs 949, Cabana Mini-Suite 143 vs 146). Accuracy is highest inside contiguous category blocks and lowest at category boundaries and on decks 5/15/16 where cruisedeckplans' image-map regions are sparse (many cabins assigned by nearest-region fallback). Category names are the cruisedeckplans marketing groupings; the finer Princess sub-codes were collapsed (all IA-IF+IS=Interior; DA-DF+D1/D2+DO=Deluxe Balcony; O2/O3/O5=Premium Oceanview; DG/DH=Cove Balcony; MA/MD/ME/M1/M2=Mini-Suite; C1/C2/CA/CB=Cabana Mini-Suite; S9=Signature Suite; S4=Vista; S2=Grand; S0=Sky). Treat individual-cabin category as a strong estimate, not a booking-grade guarantee.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow direction confirmed at the TOP of each deck SVG (low cabin sequence numbers cluster at low y, consistently across all 10 decks). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's occupied length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam at each deck's centre-x; low x = port, high x = starboard, assuming a standard viewed-from-above, bow-up deck plan. This is consistent with the observed Princess parity (even cabin numbers to port, odd to starboard). Could be uniformly mirrored if deckmaps drew the plan flipped; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps/cruisedeckplans geometry carries no obstructed-view flag here; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; NOT asserted as guaranteed clear-view).

colorLegend.#fff: No category encoding. Princess deckmaps deck SVGs render every cabin shape as white fill (#fff) with a black stroke over a monochrome background raster; category is NOT conveyed by colour (contrast Royal Caribbean). Category in this file was derived externally from cruisedeckplans.com - see sourceDetail/notes.
